title: tspi-policy/1
description: Learned guidance policy: a small feed-forward network over the versioned 'los_v1' LOS-frame observation. Inference is hand-rolled f64 in the sim (no ML runtime). The airframe g-limit is applied outside the policy. Weights are NOTIONAL.

obs.description: Observation contract: [range, closing_speed, self_speed, |los_rate|], each divided by its norm. Output: [a_e1, a_e2, a_e3] x norm.accel_mps2 in the LOS frame (e1 = toward target, e2 = LOS-rate direction, e3 = e1 x e2). Pronav is a_e3 = -N*closing*|los_rate| in this space.

w.description: Row-major weights, w[out][in]; first layer takes the 4-wide observation, last layer outputs 3
